checks: Week shows saved daily tasks, formatted notes and local images, without creating a period summary
Month lists journals newest first, preserves lists and links, and excludes trash and legacy summaries
Previous and next month move the time window correctly
Year includes all current-year daily journals and supports previous year and return to this year
Opening a dated journal returns to the editor and switching back to a period saves the last input
Calendar date selection keeps the chosen scope and updates the natural period
Period export includes only the displayed daily journals and images, and offers no bulk trash action
390px scope controls and yearly journals have no horizontal overflow
